description: Saves a preference the person stated, under a key. Saving to an existing key replaces it; body null deletes it. Up to 32 keys, 1,000 characters each. Private; returned on every profile read, separately from style notes.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

title: Save or Forget a Preference
